program_separation: This campaign is not on the critical path of the bounded normal-stability confirmation program.

resource_caps.complement_requirement: the common-metric contraction edge of the omitted normal complement is strictly stronger than the retained slow edge
resource_caps.retained_basis: sixteen slow lifted normal modes frozen on construction data; orthogonal alignment fixed before validation
resource_caps.stop_rule: Stop before U2 if R2 projection closure or R3 embeddability fails; do not spend universality-tier resources on an unclosed kernel.
